# Wavelength

> Wavelength is an AI marketing agency delivering SEO, answer-engine optimization (AEO/GEO), paid media, AI content systems, marketing automation, and analytics for growth-stage and enterprise brands.

Wavelength combines technical SEO discipline with optimization for generative answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews), so client brands are visible in both traditional search results and AI-generated answers.

## Services
- [SEO & Technical Optimization](https://www.wavelength.ai/services.html#seo): Technical audits, content architecture, and on-page optimization.
- [AEO & Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.wavelength.ai/services.html#geo): Structuring content and data so AI answer engines can find, trust, and cite a brand.
- [Paid Media & Performance Marketing](https://www.wavelength.ai/services.html#paid): Search, social, and programmatic campaigns tied to pipeline value.
- [AI Content Systems](https://www.wavelength.ai/services.html#content): AI-assisted, human-edited content production at scale.
- [Marketing Automation & CRM](https://www.wavelength.ai/services.html#automation): Lifecycle email, lead scoring, and CRM operations.
- [Analytics & Attribution](https://www.wavelength.ai/services.html#analytics): Unified reporting including AI-referral traffic.
